**Major update with enhanced data sourcing and clearer scoring for SERP analysis.**

- Added slug, displayName, and summary fields for improved skill metadata and compatibility.
- Updated version to 13.0.0 and pointed homepage to the new repo location.
- Expanded data source section, detailing zero-dependency live SERP extraction with Firecrawl and Tavily, and surfaced reliability/metrics caveats.
- Clarified how True Difficulty is scored, with explicit weighting and evidence citation requirements for each claim.
- Strengthened labeling: all metrics must be marked as Measured, User-provided, or Estimated—never present estimates as factual.
- Added advanced video SERP/YouTube outlier analysis instructions and reference material.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md for a streamlined distribution.

SERP Analysis skill initial release.

- Provides in-depth analysis of search engine results pages (SERPs), including feature detection, top result breakdowns, and ranking factor identification.
- Maps present SERP features (e.g., featured snippets, PAA, knowledge panels, AI Overviews) for any keyword.
- Explains why top-ranked pages perform well and what factors contribute to rankings.
- Assesses SERP-triggered AI content, such as AI Overviews, for optimal citation strategies.
- Offers actionable recommendations for content planning based on live SERP data or user-submitted information.
- Supports both automated data collection (with connected tools) and detailed manual workflows.
